description: Final thermal disposal of an undrained organic corpse that cannot yield deathstill water: rotten or naturally desiccated humanlike bodies, or animal remains. Fresh eligible humanlike bodies are always protected. Already-drained remains use the separate disposal bill. Colonists, prisoners, guests and other non-hostiles require explicit bill opt-in. Produces nothing. Strip any equipment you want to keep first; remaining equipment is destroyed with the body. This practical disposal method is a game adaptation, not a canonical Fremen rite.
name: dispose of unreclaimable corpse (no water)

overview.body: At the powered sietch funerary chamber, this cleanup bill accepts rotten or naturally desiccated human remains and organic animal remains. Fresh reclaimable humans are protected; already-drained remains use the separate drained-remains bill. New bills require explicit opt-in for colonists and other non-hostiles. Strip equipment first: disposal destroys retained equipment and yields no water or other products.

summary: Dispose of organic remains that cannot yield deathstill water.
